SEO.DESCRIPTION: Wine Collection of Georgia connects winemakers, professionals and wine lovers through festivals, tastings and cultural projects celebrating Georgian wine.

HERO.TITLE:
Sharing Georgian Wine
with the World
HERO.SUBTITLE: Wine Collection of Georgia connects winemakers, professionals and wine lovers through festivals, tastings and cultural projects - celebrating Georgian wine and creating opportunities for collaboration

WHAT_WE_DO.TITLE: What We Do
WHAT_WE_DO.SUBTITLE: We bring Georgian wine into conversation with people, places and cultures - connecting its producers with wine lovers and professionals, and creating opportunities for exchange and international collaboration.
WHAT_WE_DO.INFO_1: Our festivals invite visitors to discover Georgian wines and meet their makers. Tastings, forums and symposiums bring winemakers, sommeliers and international guests together, while art, music and regional traditions give each experience its own character.

PARTNERS_SUPPORT.TITLE: Partners & Support
PARTNERS_SUPPORT.CONTENT: Our projects are developed with the support of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture of Georgia and the National Wine Agency, alongside municipalities and cultural institutions across Georgia. These partnerships bring together national expertise, local knowledge and cultural perspectives, strengthening our work in promoting Georgian wine in Georgia and internationally.

PARTNERS.TITLE: Our Partner Wineries
PARTNERS.CONTENT: Meet the wineries we work with through our festivals, tastings and professional programmes - each bringing its own wines, stories and regional character to the WCG community.
